new: The [*Forget Foucault* house](../sources/media-technology-philosophy/baudrillard/baudrillard-1977-forget-foucault/SOURCE.md#baudrillard-1977-forget-foucault-q002) now **sources** a bounded primary comparison from the consulted 2007 edition, pp. 29–43 and 55–67. Baudrillard asks whether a discourse of power participates in the productive operation it describes, then develops [reversible challenge](../sources/media-technology-philosophy/baudrillard/baudrillard-1977-forget-foucault/SOURCE.md#baudrillard-1977-forget-foucault-q004). This gives the authorial question about critique and simulation a recoverable interlocutor. The orgy opening belongs instead to [*The Transparency of Evil*, Benedict’s 1993 translation, pp. 3–6](../sources/media-technology-philosophy/baudrillard/baudrillard-1990-transparency-evil/SOURCE.md#baudrillard-1990-transparency-evil-q001). The earlier satsang-mediated external-discipline/internal-desire sequence does not adjudicate Foucault’s passages. These scoped paraphrases establish neither a complete reading of Baudrillard’s volume nor quotation readiness. *The Order of Things*, *Discipline and Punish*, “The Subject and Power,” and the care-of-self works retain their separate selected-identity and passage tasks; one volume does not become their common witness.

new: The [Jung–Pauli dossier’s typological comparison](../../../dossiers/jung-pauli-psychoid.md#four-functions-two-attitudes-native-senarius) now **sources** this distinction through the consulted German introduction to *Psychologische Typen* (1921), pp. 7–13: two directions of interest orient four separately named functions, and Jung retracts his earlier identification of thinking with introversion and feeling with extraversion. That scoped witness supplies the function/attitude distinction. It does not supply a CW6 printing or English-translation collation, and *Aion* remains a different work. The historical comparison therefore retains its own source while the native `4+2` and eight determinations retain their independent derivation.
